intuition: Track the best balance after each of at most two buys and sells as prices arrive.

brute_force.approach: Try every pair of nonoverlapping buy-sell intervals and keep the best combined profit.

optimal.approach: Update four states for first buy, first sale, second buy, and second sale in one pass.

edge_cases: Fewer than two prices cannot yield a sale.
A decreasing price sequence yields zero profit.
The second transaction may be unused when one sale is optimal.
